summary: Retested CSV import in Admin › Menu after iteration_11 fixes (image_url `|| null` → `|| ""`, and error-detail stringifier). All 4 targeted scenarios PASS, verified via network response inspection (POST /api/products status===200) and DOM inspection of [data-testid='csv-errors']. Products were actually created in the DB (visible in Menu grid — screenshot captured) and cleaned up via authenticated DELETE. The critical 422 blocker from iteration_11 is fully resolved, and the '[object Object]' error rendering bug is also resolved.

issues: (Carryover, non-blocking) DialogContent still missing DialogDescription/aria-describedby — a11y console warning persists.

action_items: Optional: add <DialogDescription> to CsvImportDialog to silence Radix a11y console warning (carryover from iter11, non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: Both fixes are in place at Admin.jsx submit(): line 743 sends `image_url: r.image_url || ""` (string, satisfies backend Pydantic `image_url: str = ""`), and lines 748-750 stringify axios error detail with Array.isArray/typeof guards → human-readable messages.

Toast DOM query returned empty in my scraper (selectors did not match the sonner shadow); this is a testing-tool limitation, not a product bug — success was proven via 200 status + presence of created products in list + successful DELETE cleanup.
Admin.jsx still 1683 lines — refactor recommendation from iter11 stands but is not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 5/5 scenarios PASS (T1, T2, T3, T4, T5 regression)

seed_data_creation: Created during test: CSV_A_Test, CSV_B_Test, CSV_Semi_Test, CSV_BOM_Test, OK_Item — ALL DELETED via authenticated DELETE /api/products/{id} at end of run (5/5 cleanup responses = 200). No residue.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CSV import feature is now fully working end-to-end. If any regression suspected in future, use the exact same 4 CSV payloads and verify via network POST /api/products=200 (NOT via toast substring match, which is unreliable because 'Importer N produits' text appears in the submit button label and 'produit importé' in failure toasts). Cleanup pattern: `fetch('/api/products?menu_type=restaurant', {Authorization: 'Bearer '+token})` then DELETE by id for any name starting with 'CSV_' or equal to 'OK_Item'.
rca of the issue: N/A — the 2 iteration_11 fixes are verified working. Root cause (image_url:null → 422 + non-stringified Pydantic detail array → '[object Object]') is fully resolved.
